verdict.rationale: A live sandbox API endpoint (api.sandbox.namecheap.com) exists and answers like production, asking for APIUser credentials. That shows a separate test environment, and the Go SDK flags production Create/Renew calls as charge-bearing. The evidence is only bare endpoint responses, though: nothing documents how a developer gets API credentials self-serve, and nothing states that sandbox registrations are free. Missing for 10: documentation of self-serve API key or credential provisioning (including any approval or IP-whitelisting steps), explicit confirmation that sandbox registrations incur no real charges, and hands-on corroboration of a full sandbox register flow.
